Container.Name: ip-directory
Container.Overview: Names every IP seen on the network. Reads sFlow samples from InfluxDB, names LAN devices by MAC, Plex users from Tautulli, clients from AdGuard Home, and everything else by owner and location (MaxMind GeoLite2). Writes the names back to InfluxDB for Grafana, with a web UI to browse and edit them. LAN/Tailscale only - there is no login.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the IP-Directory web UI

Config.Name: InfluxDB URL
Config.Description: InfluxDB v2 holding the sFlow data

Config.Name: InfluxDB Token
Config.Description: Token with read AND write access to the bucket (reads sFlow, writes ip_labels)

Config.Name: InfluxDB Bucket
Config.Description: Bucket with the netflow measurement; labels are written here too

Config.Name: Tautulli URL
Config.Description: e.g. http://192.168.1.30:8181 - leave blank to skip Plex users

Config.Name: Tautulli API Key
Config.Description: Tautulli - Settings - Web Interface - API key

Config.Name: AdGuard URL
Config.Description: AdGuard Home web address - leave blank to skip. On macvlan (br0), enable Settings - Docker - Host access to custom networks

Config.Name: MaxMind Account ID
Config.Description: Free GeoLite2 account at maxmind.com - leave blank to skip owner/location

Config.Name: Refresh Minutes
Config.Description: How often to scan sFlow and refresh sources

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames the web UI may be opened by (e.g. unraid.tailnet.ts.net, ipdir.example.com). IP addresses always work. Blocks DNS-rebinding attacks.

Config.Name: LAN CIDRs
Config.Description: Ranges treated as LAN (named by MAC)
